class CoughSymptom extends SymptomBase
{
	const int COUGH_BLOOD_LOSS = 50;
	//this is just for the Symptom parameters set-up and is called even if the Symptom doesn't execute, don't put any gameplay code in here
	override void OnInit()
	{
		m_SymptomType = SymptomTypes.PRIMARY;
		m_Priority = 100;
		m_ID = SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_COUGH;
		m_DestroyOnAnimFinish = true;
		m_SyncToClient = false;
	}
	
	bool IsContaminationActive()
	{
		return m_Player.GetModifiersManager().IsModifierActive(eModifiers.MDF_CONTAMINATION2) || m_Player.GetModifiersManager().IsModifierActive(eModifiers.MDF_CONTAMINATION3);
	}
	
	
	//!gets called every frame
	override void OnUpdateServer(PlayerBase player, float deltatime)
	{

	}

	override void OnUpdateClient(PlayerBase player, float deltatime)
	{
	}
	
	override void OnAnimationStart()
	{
		if ( IsContaminationActive() )
		{
			PluginLifespan module_lifespan = PluginLifespan.Cast( GetPlugin( PluginLifespan ) );
			module_lifespan.UpdateBloodyHandsVisibilityEx( m_Player, eBloodyHandsTypes.JUST_BLOOD );
		}
	}
	
	
	override SmptAnimMetaBase SpawnAnimMetaObject()
	{
		return new SmptAnimMetaADD();
	}
	
	//!gets called once on an Symptom which is being activated
	override void OnGetActivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if( m_Manager.GetCurrentCommandID() == DayZPlayerConstants.COMMANDID_MOVE && !player.IsRaised() && player.GetCommand_Move() && player.GetCommand_Move() && !player.GetCommand_Move().IsOnBack())
		{
			PlayAnimationADD(1);
		}
		else
		{
			PlaySound(EPlayerSoundEventID.SYMPTOM_COUGH);
		}
		player.SpreadAgentsEx(3);
		
		if ( IsContaminationActive() )
			player.AddHealth("","Blood", -COUGH_BLOOD_LOSS);
	}

	//!gets called once on a Symptom which is being activated
	override void OnGetActivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		//if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	//!only gets called once on an active Symptom that is being deactivated
	override void OnGetDeactivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		//if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	//!only gets called once on an active Symptom that is being deactivated
	override void OnGetDeactivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		//if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}
}

# FILE: Scripts And Configs\scripts\4_world\classes\playersymptoms\states\primary\vomitstate.c
# FULL PATH: P:\FILES\Scripts And Configs\scripts\4_world\classes\playersymptoms\states\primary\vomitstate.c
# SIZE: 2633 bytes
########################################
class VomitSymptom : SymptomBase
{
	static const float STAMINA_DEPLETION_MULTIPLIER	= 1.3;
	static const float STAMINA_RECOVERY_MULTIPLIER 	= 0.5;

	//just for the Symptom parameters set-up and gets called even if the Symptom doesn't execute, don't put any gameplay code in here
	const int BLOOD_LOSS = 250;
	const int STOMACH_CONTENT_PERCENTAGE_DEFAULT = 5; //per second
	
	private float m_VomitContentPercentage = -1; //considered unspecified at -1
	
	override void OnInit()
	{
		m_SymptomType = SymptomTypes.PRIMARY;
		m_Priority = 100;
		m_ID = SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_VOMIT;
		m_DestroyOnAnimFinish = true;
		m_SyncToClient = false;
		m_Duration = 5;
		m_MaxCount = 1;
		m_VomitContentPercentage = -1;
	}
	
	bool IsContaminationActive()
	{
		return m_Player.GetModifiersManager().IsModifierActive(eModifiers.MDF_CONTAMINATION2) || m_Player.GetModifiersManager().IsModifierActive(eModifiers.MDF_CONTAMINATION3);
	}
	
	override void SetParam(Param p)
	{
		Param1<float> p1 = Param1<float>.Cast(p);
		if ( p1 )
		{
			m_VomitContentPercentage = p1.param1;
		}
	}
	
	override void OnAnimationStart()
	{
		if (m_Player)
		{
			m_Player.GetStatToxicity().Set(0);
			if (m_Player.m_PlayerStomach)
			{
				if (m_VomitContentPercentage < 0) //unspecified, calculate from duration
				{
					float contentLoss = STOMACH_CONTENT_PERCENTAGE_DEFAULT * m_Duration;
					m_Player.m_PlayerStomach.ReduceContents(contentLoss);
				}
				else
					m_Player.m_PlayerStomach.ReduceContents(m_VomitContentPercentage);
			}
			
			if (IsContaminationActive())
				m_Player.AddHealth("","Blood", -BLOOD_LOSS);
		}
	}
	
	override void OnAnimationFinish()
	{
		//! deplete stamina
		m_Player.GetStaminaHandler().DepleteStaminaEx(EStaminaModifiers.OVERALL_DRAIN);
		
		if (IsContaminationActive())
		{
			PluginLifespan module_lifespan = PluginLifespan.Cast( GetPlugin( PluginLifespan ) );
			module_lifespan.UpdateBloodyHandsVisibilityEx( m_Player, eBloodyHandsTypes.JUST_BLOOD );
		}
	}
	
	override bool CanActivate()
	{
		return ( m_Manager.GetCurrentCommandID() == DayZPlayerConstants.COMMANDID_MOVE || m_Manager.GetCurrentCommandID() == DayZPlayerConstants.COMMANDID_ACTION );
	}	
	
	//!gets called once on an Symptom which is being activated
	override void OnGetActivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		PlayAnimationFB(DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_VOMIT,DayZPlayerConstants.STANCEMASK_CROUCH, GetDuration() );
	}

	override SmptAnimMetaBase SpawnAnimMetaObject()
	{
		return new SmptAnimMetaFB();
	}
	
	override bool IsSyncToRemotes()
	{
		return true;
	}
}

########################################
class FaintSymptom : SymptomBase
{
	private float m_Intensity;
	private float m_FadeoutDuration;
	private float m_Interval;
	
	private ref PPERequester_UnconEffects m_FaintEffect;
	
	//this is just for the Symptom parameters set-up and is called even if the Symptom doesn't execute, don't put any gameplay code in here
	override void OnInit()
	{
		m_Priority 				= 0;
		m_SymptomType 			= SymptomTypes.SECONDARY;
		m_ID 					= SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_FAINT;
		m_DestroyOnAnimFinish 	= false;
		m_IsPersistent 			= false;
		m_ServerUpdateInterval	= 5.0;
		m_SyncToClient			= true;
		
		if (!g_Game.IsDedicatedServer())
			m_FaintEffect = PPERequester_UnconEffects.Cast(PPERequesterBank.GetRequester(PPERequester_UnconEffects));
	}
	
	override void SetParam(Param p)
	{
		Param2<int, ref SymptomSyncData> params = Param2<int, ref SymptomSyncData>.Cast(p);
		if (params && params.param1 == SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_FAINT)
		{
			if (!g_Game.IsDedicatedServer())
			{
				SymptomSyncData faintData = params.param2;
				if (faintData.m_IntArray[0] == 1)
				{
					if (!m_FaintEffect.IsRequesterRunning())
					{
						Param1<float> vignette = new Param1<float>(0.0);
						m_FaintEffect.Start(vignette);
					}
					m_FaintEffect.FadeInEffect(faintData.m_FloatArray[0], faintData.m_FloatArray[1]);
				}
				else if (faintData.m_IntArray[0] == 0)
					m_FaintEffect.FadeOutEffect(faintData.m_FloatArray[0] + faintData.m_FloatArray[1]);
				else if (faintData.m_IntArray[0] == 2)
				{
					m_FaintEffect.FadeOutEffect(0.3);
					m_FaintEffect.SetRequesterUpdating(false);
				}
			}
		}
		
		#ifdef SERVER
		g_Game.RPCSingleParam(m_Player, ERPCs.RPC_SYMPTOM_PARAM_SYNC, params, true, m_Player.GetIdentity());
		#endif
	}

	override void OnGetActivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}
	
	//!only gets called once on an active Symptom that is being deactivated
	override void OnGetDeactivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	override void OnDestructed()
	{
		super.OnDestructed();

		if (!g_Game.IsDedicatedServer())
			m_FaintEffect.Stop();
	}
}

########################################
class FeverBlurSymptom extends SymptomBase
{
	Material m_MatGauss;

	float m_BlurDuration;
	float m_BlurStrength;
	float m_EffectTime;
	float m_EffectStartTime;
	float m_Time;
	protected PPERequester_FeverEffects 	m_Requester;
	
	const float BLUR_STRENGTH_MIN = 0.15;
	const float BLUR_STRENGTH_MAX = 0.25;
	
	const int BLUR_DURATION_TIME_MIN = 1.5;
	const int BLUR_DURATION_TIME_MAX = 2.5;
	
	const int MIN_TIME_BETWEEN_EFFECTS = 25.0;
	const int MAX_TIME_BETWEEN_EFFECTS = 35.0;

	//this is just for the Symptom parameters set-up and is called even if the Symptom doesn't execute, don't put any gameplay code in here
	override void OnInit()
	{
		m_SymptomType = SymptomTypes.SECONDARY;
		m_Priority = 0;
		m_ID = SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_FEVERBLUR;
		m_DestroyOnAnimFinish = true;
		m_IsPersistent = false;
		m_SyncToClient = true;
		
		if ( !g_Game.IsHeadlessOrDedicatedServer() )
		{
			Class.CastTo(m_Requester,PPERequesterBank.GetRequester(PPERequester_FeverEffects));
		}
	}
	
	//!gets called every frame
	override void OnUpdateServer(PlayerBase player, float deltatime)
	{
		//int i = 1 + 1;
	}

	
	override void OnUpdateClient(PlayerBase player, float deltatime)
	{
		#ifndef NO_GUI
		m_Time += deltatime;
		if ( m_EffectStartTime <= 0 )
		{
			m_EffectStartTime = Math.RandomFloatInclusive(MIN_TIME_BETWEEN_EFFECTS, MAX_TIME_BETWEEN_EFFECTS);
			m_BlurDuration = Math.RandomFloatInclusive(BLUR_DURATION_TIME_MIN, BLUR_DURATION_TIME_MAX);
			m_BlurStrength = Math.RandomFloat(BLUR_STRENGTH_MIN, BLUR_STRENGTH_MAX);
			//PrintString("m_BlurDuration=" +m_BlurDuration.ToString());
		}
		
		if ( m_EffectStartTime > 0 && m_Time > m_EffectStartTime )
		{
			m_EffectTime += deltatime / m_BlurDuration;
			float cos_value = Math.Sin(m_EffectTime  * Math.PI);
			float val = cos_value * m_BlurStrength;
			//Print(val);
			m_Requester.SetFeverIntensity(val);
			//PrintString("cos=" +cos_value.ToString());
			
			if ( m_EffectTime >= 1 )
			{
				m_EffectTime = 0;
				m_EffectStartTime = -1;
				m_Time = 0;
			}
		}
		#endif
	}
	
	//!gets called once on an Symptom which is being activated
	override void OnGetActivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	override void OnGetActivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	override void OnGetDeactivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}
	
	//!only gets called once on an active Symptom that is being deactivated
	override void OnGetDeactivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		m_Requester.Stop();
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable()) Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}
}

		{

		{

class SquintSymptom : SymptomBase
{
	//this is just for the Symptom parameters set-up and is called even if the Symptom doesn't execute, don't put any gameplay code in here
	override void OnInit()
	{
		m_Priority 				= 0;
		m_SymptomType 			= SymptomTypes.SECONDARY;
		m_ID 					= SymptomIDs.SYMPTOM_SQUINT;
		m_DestroyOnAnimFinish 	= true;
		m_IsPersistent 			= false;
		m_ServerUpdateInterval	= 5.0;
		m_SyncToClient			= true;
	}
	
	override bool AllowInUnconscious()
	{
		return true;
	}
	
	override void OnUpdateClient(PlayerBase player, float deltatime)
	{
		if (player.IsUnconscious())
			return;

		CachedEquipmentStorageQuery query = new CachedEquipmentStorageQuery();
		query.m_Category = ECachedEquipmentItemCategory.EYEWEAR|ECachedEquipmentItemCategory.MASK;
		query.m_Placement = ECachedEquipmentPlacement.ATTACHMENT;
		query.m_MaximumDepth = 2;

		float protectionLevel = 0.0;
		ItemBase coverItem = null;
		array<Entity> coverItems = player.GetCachedEquipment().GetEntitiesByCategory(query);
		int coverItemsCount = coverItems.Count();
		for (int i = 0; i < coverItemsCount; ++i)
		{
			coverItem = ItemBase.Cast(coverItems[i]);
			protectionLevel = coverItem.GetProtectionLevel(DEF_DUST_PARTICLE_EYES);
			if (protectionLevel > 0.0)
				break;
		}

		float sandstormIntensity;
		ScriptedSandstormController sandstorm = ScriptedSandstormController.Cast(g_Game.GetWeather().GetSandstorm());
		if (sandstorm)
			sandstormIntensity = sandstorm.GetIntensityForPlayer(player);

		float squintIntensity = Math.Clamp(sandstormIntensity - protectionLevel, 0.0, 1.0);
		
		Param1<float> params = new Param1<float>(squintIntensity);
		g_Game.GetMission().GetEffectWidgets().UpdateWidgets(EffectWidgetsTypes.SQUINTING, deltatime, params, EffectWidgetHandles.SQUINTING);
	}

	//!gets called once on an Symptom which is being activated
	override void OnGetActivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}

	override void OnGetActivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetActivated", m_Player.ToString());
		
		g_Game.GetMission().GetEffectWidgets().AddActiveEffects({EffectWidgetsTypes.SQUINTING});
	}

	override void OnGetDeactivatedServer(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());
	}
	
	//!only gets called once on an active Symptom that is being deactivated
	override void OnGetDeactivatedClient(PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (LogManager.IsSymptomLogEnable())
			Debug.SymptomLog("n/a", this.ToString(), "n/a", "OnGetDeactivated", m_Player.ToString());

		g_Game.GetMission().GetEffectWidgets().RemoveActiveEffects({EffectWidgetsTypes.SQUINTING});
	}
	
}

class ConstructionPartEffectsData

	/////////

	void Init(string partPath, ConstructionPartTypeData typeDataObject)
	{
		string effectPath = partPath + " EffectsData";
		if (!g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(effectPath)) //none of this is valid without an existing class
			return;
		
		int materialType = typeDataObject.GetMaterialType();
		
		//none of this is valid without SOME defined position points..
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(effectPath + " soundEffectPositions")) 
		{
			g_Game.ConfigGetTextArray(effectPath + " soundEffectPositions", m_SoundEffectMemoryPointNames);
			
			if (m_SoundEffectMemoryPointNames.Count() > 0)
			{
				m_IsValid = true;
				InitConstructionSoundsData(effectPath, materialType);
			}
		}
		
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(effectPath + " particleEffectPositions")) 
		{
			g_Game.ConfigGetTextArray(effectPath + " particleEffectPositions", m_ParticleEffectMemoryPointNames);
			
			if (m_ParticleEffectMemoryPointNames.Count() > 0)
			{
				m_IsValid = true;
				InitConstructionParticleData(effectPath, materialType);
			}
		}
	}
	
	protected void InitConstructionSoundsData(string effectPath, int materialType)
	{
		InitBuildSoundset(effectPath + " build_soundset_override", materialType);
		InitDismantleSoundset(effectPath + " dismantle_soundset_override", materialType);
		InitDestroySoundset(effectPath + " destroy_soundset_override", materialType);
	}
	
	protected void InitConstructionParticleData(string effectPath, int materialType)
	{
		InitDestroyParticle(effectPath + " destroy_particle_override", materialType);
	}
	
	protected void InitBuildSoundset(string path, int materialType)
	{
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(path))
		{
			m_PartBuildSoundset = g_Game.ConfigGetTextOut(path);
		}
		else
		{
			m_PartBuildSoundset = DefaultBuildSoundset(materialType);
		}
	}
	
	protected void InitDismantleSoundset(string path, int materialType)
	{
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(path))
		{
			m_PartDismantleSoundset = g_Game.ConfigGetTextOut(path);
		}
		else
		{
			m_PartDismantleSoundset = DefaultDismantleSoundset(materialType);

	}
	
	protected void InitDestroySoundset(string path, int materialType)
	{

		{
			m_PartDestroySoundset = g_Game.ConfigGetTextOut(path);
		}
		else
		{
			m_PartDestroySoundset = DefaultDestroySoundset(materialType);
		}
	}
	
	protected void InitDestroyParticle(string path, int materialType)
	{
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(path))
		{
			m_PartDestroyParticleID = ParticleList.RegisterParticleByFullPath(g_Game.ConfigGetTextOut(path)); //look for warnings in the log if your particle does not play
		}
		else
		{
			m_PartDestroyParticleID = DefaultDestroyParticle(materialType);
		}
	}
	
	////////////
	//defaults//
	////////////
	
	protected string DefaultBuildSoundset(int materialType)
	{
		string soundset = "";
		switch (materialType)
		{
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_LOG:
				soundset = BaseBuildingBase.SOUND_BUILD_WOOD_LOG;
				break;
			
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_WOOD:
				soundset = "BuildWood_SoundSet";
				break;
			
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_STAIRS:
				soundset = BaseBuildingBase.SOUND_BUILD_WOOD_STAIRS;
				break;
			
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_METAL:
				soundset = "BuildMetal_SoundSet";

	protected string DefaultDismantleSoundset(int materialType)
	{
		string soundset = "";

		{
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_LOG:

			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_STAIRS:

			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_WIRE:

			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_WOOD:

				break;
			
			case ConstructionMaterialType.MATERIAL_STAIRS:
				soundset = "DestroyWood_SoundSet";

class ConstructionPartStaticsSupportData
{
	protected ref map<int, ref StaticsSupportCategoryValues> m_ValueMap;
	protected ref set<int> m_ConfiguredCategories;
	
	void Init(string partPath)
	{
		//prevents double initialization
		if (m_ValueMap)
			return;
		
		m_ConfiguredCategories = new set<int>();
		string pathBase = partPath + " StaticsSupportData";
		if (g_Game.ConfigIsExisting(pathBase))
		{
			string childName;
			string supportCategory;
			int supportStrength;
			int i;
			
			m_ValueMap = new map<int, ref StaticsSupportCategoryValues>();
			map<int, int> requirementMap = new map<int, int>();
			map<int, int> providerMap = new map<int, int>();
			
			//support provider data basic parse
			string path = pathBase + " SupportProviders";
			int count = g_Game.ConfigGetChildrenCount(path);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				for (i = 0; i < count; ++i)
				{
					childName = "";
					supportCategory = "";
					supportStrength = 0;
					
					g_Game.ConfigGetChildName(path, i, childName);
					g_Game.ConfigGetTextRaw(path + " " + childName + " supportCategory", supportCategory);
					supportStrength = g_Game.ConfigGetInt(path + " " + childName + " supportStrength");
					providerMap.Insert(supportCategory.Hash(), supportStrength);
					m_ConfiguredCategories.Insert(supportCategory.Hash());
				}
			}
			
			//support requirements data basic parse
			path = pathBase + " SupportRequirements";
			count = g_Game.ConfigGetChildrenCount(path);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				for (i = 0; i < count; ++i)
				{
					childName = "";
					supportCategory = "";
					supportStrength = 0;
					
					g_Game.ConfigGetChildName(path, i, childName);
					g_Game.ConfigGetTextRaw(path + " " + childName + " supportCategory", supportCategory);
					supportStrength = g_Game.ConfigGetInt(path + " " + childName + " supportStrength");
					requirementMap.Insert(supportCategory.Hash(), supportStrength);
					m_ConfiguredCategories.Insert(supportCategory.Hash());
				}
			}
			
			//now insert as 'StaticsSupportCategoryValues'
			foreach (int category : m_ConfiguredCategories)
			{
				m_ValueMap.Insert(category, new StaticsSupportCategoryValues(category, providerMap.Get(category), requirementMap.Get(category)));
			}
		}
	}
	
	int GetSupportProvided(int category)
	{
		if (!m_ValueMap || !m_ValueMap.Contains(category))
			return 0;
		
		return m_ValueMap.Get(category).m_ProvidedSupport;
	}
	
	int GetSupportRequirement(int category)
	{
		if (!m_ValueMap || !m_ValueMap.Contains(category))
			return 0;
		
		return m_ValueMap.Get(category).m_RequiredSupport;
	}
	
	set<int> GetConfiguredSupportCategories()
	{
		return m_ConfiguredCategories;
	}
}

class StaticsSupportCategoryValues
{
	int m_Category;
	int m_ProvidedSupport;
	int m_RequiredSupport;
	
	void StaticsSupportCategoryValues(int category, int provides, int requires)
	{
		m_Category = category;
		m_ProvidedSupport = provides;
		m_RequiredSupport = requires;
	}
}

class Rebuilding : ConstructionBase
{
	static int REBUILDING_STORAGE_VERSION = 1;

	protected int m_SyncParts5;
	protected int m_SyncParts6;
	protected int m_SyncParts7;
	protected int m_SyncParts8;
	protected int m_SyncParts9;
	protected int m_SyncParts10;
	protected int m_SyncParts1Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts2Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts3Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts4Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts5Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts6Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts7Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts8Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts9Local;
	protected int m_SyncParts10Local;
	
	protected ref map<int, int> m_SupportRequirement;
	protected ref map<int, int> m_SupportFulfillment;
	
	//BuildPart
	override void BuildPartServerEx(Man player, string part_name, int action_id)
	{
		super.BuildPartServerEx(player,part_name,action_id);
		
		ProcessOnPartBuiltServer(player, part_name, action_id);
	}
	
	//DismantlePart
	override void DismantlePartServerEx(Man player, string part_name, int action_id)
	{
		super.DismantlePartServerEx(player,part_name,action_id);
		
		ProcessOnPartDismantledServer(player, part_name, action_id);
	}
	
	//DestroyPart
	override void DestroyPartServer(Man player, string part_name, int action_id, bool destroyed_by_connected_part = false)
	{
		//set DamageZone health to zero
		string damage_zone;
		if (DamageSystem.GetDamageZoneFromComponentName(m_EntityParent, part_name, damage_zone) && m_EntityParent.GetHealth(damage_zone, "Health") > 0)
		{
			m_EntityParent.SetHealth(damage_zone, "Health", 0);
		}
		
		super.DestroyPartServer(player,part_name,action_id,destroyed_by_connected_part);
		
		ProcessOnPartDestroyedServer(player, part_name, action_id, destroyed_by_connected_part);
	}
	
	//============================================
	// Syncing
	//============================================
	
	override void OnConstructionVariablesSynchronized()
	{
		super.OnConstructionVariablesSynchronized();
		
		HandleSyncedParts();
	}
	
	protected void HandleSyncedParts()
	{
		bool changed = false;
		if (m_SyncParts1Local != m_SyncParts1)
		{
			m_SyncParts1Local = m_SyncParts1;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts2Local != m_SyncParts2)
		{
			m_SyncParts2Local = m_SyncParts2;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts3Local != m_SyncParts3)
		{
			m_SyncParts3Local = m_SyncParts3;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts4Local != m_SyncParts4)
		{
			m_SyncParts4Local = m_SyncParts4;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts5Local != m_SyncParts5)
		{
			m_SyncParts5Local = m_SyncParts5;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts6Local != m_SyncParts6)
		{
			m_SyncParts6Local = m_SyncParts6;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts7Local != m_SyncParts7)
		{
			m_SyncParts7Local = m_SyncParts7;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts8Local != m_SyncParts8)
		{
			m_SyncParts8Local = m_SyncParts8;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts9Local != m_SyncParts9)
		{
			m_SyncParts9Local = m_SyncParts9;
			changed = true;
		}
		if (m_SyncParts10Local != m_SyncParts10)
		{
			m_SyncParts10Local = m_SyncParts10;
			changed = true;
		}
		
		//do local client stuff here
		if (changed)
		{
			array<ConstructionPart> changedParts = new array<ConstructionPart>();
			if (SetAllPartsFromSyncData(changedParts))
			{
				QueueFullUpdateParts(changedParts);
			}
			changedParts = null;
		}
	}
	
	override void HandleSyncDataBuild(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		int partId = part.GetId();
		if (partId <= 0)
			return;
		
		//in case of variable part sync data sizes, prepare some map with info to be used in the switch. Sadly the syncVariables themselves can't be handled as such.
		int adjustedID = Math.Clamp((partId - 1), 0, int.MAX) * part.GetSyncDataSize();
		int syncIntIdx = adjustedID / BIT_INT_SIZE;
		int offset = adjustedID % BIT_INT_SIZE;
		
		switch (syncIntIdx)
		{
			case 0:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts1, offset);
			break;
			
			case 1:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts2, offset);
			break;
			
			case 2:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts3, offset);
			break;
			
			case 3:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts4, offset);
			break;
			
			case 4:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts5, offset);
			break;
			
			case 5:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts6, offset);
			break;
			
			case 6:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts7, offset);
			break;
			
			case 7:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts8, offset);
			break;
			
			case 8:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts9, offset);
			break;
			
			case 9:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnBuild(m_SyncParts10, offset);
			break;
		}
	}
	
	override void HandleSyncDataDismantle(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		int partId = part.GetId();
		if (partId <= 0)
			return;
		
		int adjustedID = Math.Clamp((partId - 1), 0, int.MAX) * part.GetSyncDataSize();
		int syncIntIdx = adjustedID / BIT_INT_SIZE;
		int offset = adjustedID % BIT_INT_SIZE;
		
		switch (syncIntIdx)
		{
			case 0:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts1, offset);
			break;
			
			case 1:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts2, offset);
			break;
			
			case 2:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts3, offset);
			break;
			
			case 3:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts4, offset);
			break;
			
			case 4:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts5, offset);
			break;
			
			case 5:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts6, offset);
			break;
			
			case 6:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts7, offset);
			break;
			
			case 7:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts8, offset);
			break;
			
			case 8:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts9, offset);
			break;
			
			case 9:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDismantle(m_SyncParts10, offset);
			break;
		}
	}
	
	override void HandleSyncDataDestroy(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		int partId = part.GetId();
		if (partId <= 0)
			return;
		
		int adjustedID = Math.Clamp((partId - 1), 0, int.MAX) * part.GetSyncDataSize();
		int syncIntIdx = adjustedID / BIT_INT_SIZE;
		int offset = adjustedID % BIT_INT_SIZE;
		
		switch (syncIntIdx)
		{
			case 0:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts1, offset);
			break;
			
			case 1:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts2, offset);
			break;
			
			case 2:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts3, offset);
			break;
			
			case 3:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts4, offset);
			break;
			
			case 4:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts5, offset);
			break;
			
			case 5:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts6, offset);
			break;
			
			case 6:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts7, offset);
			break;
			
			case 7:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts8, offset);
			break;
			
			case 8:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts9, offset);
			break;
			
			case 9:
				part.ComposeSyncDataOnDestroy(m_SyncParts10, offset);
			break;
		}
	}
	
	//! Returns the translated value of 'GetSyncDataSize' size (currently 2 bits)
	int GetPartLocalSyncBitMaskValue(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		int partId = part.GetId();
		if (partId <= 0)
			return false;
		
		int adjustedID = Math.Clamp((partId - 1), 0, int.MAX) * part.GetSyncDataSize();
		int syncIntIdx = adjustedID / BIT_INT_SIZE;
		int offset = adjustedID % BIT_INT_SIZE;
		int tmp;
		
		switch (syncIntIdx)
		{
			case 0:
				tmp = m_SyncParts1;
			break;
			
			case 1:
				tmp = m_SyncParts2;
			break;
			
			case 2:
				tmp = m_SyncParts3;
			break;
			
			case 3:
				tmp = m_SyncParts4;
			break;
			
			case 4:
				tmp = m_SyncParts5;
			break;
			
			case 5:
				tmp = m_SyncParts6;
			break;
			
			case 6:
				tmp = m_SyncParts7;
			break;
			
			case 7:
				tmp = m_SyncParts8;
			break;
			
			case 8:
				tmp = m_SyncParts9;
			break;
			
			case 9:
				tmp = m_SyncParts10;
			break;
		}
		
		return part.CalculateLocalSyncBitMask(tmp, offset);
	}
	
	//! returns 'true' if any part state was changed
	bool SetAllPartsFromSyncData(out array<ConstructionPart> changedParts = null)
	{
		bool wasChanged = false;
		
		foreach (ConstructionPart part : m_ConstructionPartArray)
		{
			if (UpdatePartSyncStateLocal(part))
			{
				if (changedParts)
					changedParts.Insert(part);
				wasChanged = true;
			}
		}
		
		return wasChanged;
	}
	
	//! Sets local construction part state
	override bool UpdatePartSyncStateLocal(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		if (part.GetId() < 1)
		{
			if (!part.IsUtilityPart())
				ErrorEx("invalid or corrupted part ID for part " + part.GetPartName() + ". Part ID must be > 0");
			return false;
		}
		
		part.StoreLocalSyncBitMask(GetPartLocalSyncBitMaskValue(part)); //stores translated synced info on the local part instance
		return SetPartStateLocal(part);
	}
	
	protected bool SetPartStateLocal(ConstructionPart part)
	{
		bool changed = false;
		bool isSyncedAsBuilt = part.IsLocalSyncBuilt();
		bool isBuilt = part.IsBuilt();
		string name = part.GetPartName();
		if (isSyncedAsBuilt)
		{
			if (!isBuilt)
			{
				AddToConstructedParts(name);
				SetLockOnAttachedMaterials(name, true);
				changed = true;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (isBuilt)
			{
				RemoveFromConstructedParts(name);
				SetLockOnAttachedMaterials(name, false);
				changed = true;
			}
		}
		
		return changed;
	}
	
	override void AddToConstructedParts(string part_name)
	{
		AddSupportFulfillmentFromSourcePart(part_name);
		AddSupportRequirementFromSourcePart(part_name);
		
		super.AddToConstructedParts(part_name);
	}
	
	override void RemoveFromConstructedParts(string part_name)
	{
		RemoveSupportFulfillmentFromSourcePart(part_name);
		RemoveSupportRequirementFromSourcePart(part_name);
		
		super.RemoveFromConstructedParts(part_name);
	}
	
	//============================================
	// Events
	//============================================
	override void OnConstructionDoorOpenStart(DoorStartParams params)
	{
		super.OnConstructionDoorOpenStart(params);
		
		int doorIdx = (int)params.param1;
		BuildingBase building;
		AdditionalDoorInfo info;
		if (Class.CastTo(building, m_EntityParent) && Class.CastTo(info, building.GetDoorInfo(doorIdx)) && info.m_DoorConstructionPhysicsSource != string.Empty)
		{
			building.SetAnimationPhase(info.m_DoorConstructionPhysicsSource, 1.0);
		}
	}
	
	override void OnConstructionDoorCloseStart(DoorStartParams params)
	{
		super.OnConstructionDoorCloseStart(params);
		
		int doorIdx = (int)params.param1;
		BuildingBase building;
		AdditionalDoorInfo info;
		if (Class.CastTo(building, m_EntityParent) && Class.CastTo(info, building.GetDoorInfo(doorIdx)) && info.m_DoorConstructionPhysicsSource != string.Empty)
		{
			building.SetAnimationPhase(info.m_DoorConstructionPhysicsSource, 0.0);
		}
	}
	
	//============================================
	// Persistence
	//============================================
	override bool HandleStorageEvents()
	{
		return true;
	}
	
	override void HandleStoreSave(ParamsWriteContext ctx)
	{
		if (HandleStorageEvents())
		{
			super.HandleStoreSave(ctx);
			
			SerializeConstructionData(ctx);
		}
	}
	
	override void HandleStoreLoad(ParamsReadContext ctx, int version)
	{
		if (HandleStorageEvents())
		{
			super.HandleStoreLoad(ctx,version);
			
			if (!DeserializeConstructionData(ctx,version))
				ErrorEx("deserialization of construction data of " + m_EntityParent.GetType() + " FAILED, presumed corrupted data",ErrorExSeverity.INFO);
			
			//true if changed, we need to react to and sync the changes to clients
			if (SetAllPartsFromSyncData())
			{
				QueueFullUpdateParts(m_ConstructionPartArray);
			}
			m_EntityParent.SetSynchDirty();
		}
	}
	
	protected void SerializeConstructionData(ParamsWriteContext ctx)
	{
		ctx.Write(REBUILDING_STORAGE_VERSION);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts1);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts2);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts3);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts4);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts5);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts6);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts7);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts8);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts9);
		ctx.Write(m_SyncParts10);
	}
	
	protected bool DeserializeConstructionData(ParamsReadContext ctx, int version)
	{
		if (!ctx.Read(m_LastStorageVersion))
			return false;
		if (m_LastStorageVersion < REBUILDING_STORAGE_VERSION)
		{
			ErrorEx("Invalid rebuilding storage version | " + m_LastStorageVersion + "/" + REBUILDING_STORAGE_VERSION, ErrorExSeverity.INFO);
			return false;
		}
		
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts1))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts2))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts3))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts4))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts5))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts6))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts7))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts8))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts9))
			return false;
		if (!ctx.Read(m_SyncParts10))
			return false;
		
		return true;
	}
	
	//============================================
	// Inits
	//============================================
	override void Init()
	{
		super.Init();
		
		InitSupportMap();
	}
	
	protected void InitBaseStateDeferred()
	{
		QueueFullUpdateParts(m_ConstructionPartArray);
	}
	
	override void InitBaseState()
	{
		g_Game.GetCallQueue(CALL_CATEGORY_SYSTEM).Call(InitBaseStateDeferred);
	}
	
	protected void InitSupportMap()
	{
		if (!m_SupportFulfillment)
			m_SupportFulfillment = new map<int, int>();
		
		if (!m_SupportRequirement)
			m_SupportRequirement = new map<int, int>();
	}
	
	override protected typename GetDefaultPartInstanceTypename()
	{
		return ConstructionPartRebuild;
	}
	
	//============================================
	// Parts
	//============================================
	protected ConstructionPartRebuild GetRebuildingPart(string part_name)
	{
		return ConstructionPartRebuild.Cast(GetConstructionPart(part_name));
	}
	
	//! Also checks for all listed variant categories (at least 1 from each is required)
	override protected bool HasRequiredPart(string part_name)
	{
		//simple requirements check
		if (!super.HasRequiredPart(part_name))
			return false;
		
		//now look into weighted variants
		TConstructionPartVariantArray tmp = GetRebuildingPart(part_name).GetRequiredPartsVariants();
		if (tmp)
		{
			bool anyVariantBuilt = false;
			foreach (array<string> variantGroup : tmp)
			{
				anyVariantBuilt = false;
				foreach (string partName : variantGroup)
				{
					anyVariantBuilt |= IsPartConstructed(partName);
				}
				
				if (!anyVariantBuilt)
					return false;
			}
		}
		
		return true;
	}
	
	////////////
	//supports//
	////////////
	
	override protected bool PartHasAnySupportFulfilled(string part_name)
	{
		if (!super.PartHasAnySupportFulfilled(part_name))
			return false;
		
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		if (tmp.Count() > 0) //can fail only if some support category is defined
		{
			foreach (int category : tmp)
			{
				if (rebPart.GetSupportRequirement(category) <= m_SupportFulfillment.Get(category))
					return true;
			}
			
			return false;
		}
		
		return true;
	}
	
	override bool SupportRemovalCheck(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		foreach (int category : tmp)
		{
			if (m_SupportRequirement.Get(category) > (m_SupportFulfillment.Get(category) - rebPart.GetSupportProvided(category)))
				return false;
		}
		
		return true;
	}
	
	protected void AddSupportFulfillmentFromSourcePart(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		int value;
		foreach (int category : tmp)
		{
			value = rebPart.GetSupportProvided(category);
			if (m_SupportFulfillment.Contains(category))
			{
				value = Math.Clamp(m_SupportFulfillment.Get(category) + value, 0, int.MAX);
			}
			m_SupportFulfillment.Set(category, value);
		}
	}
	
	protected void RemoveSupportFulfillmentFromSourcePart(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		int value;
		foreach (int category : tmp)
		{
			value = rebPart.GetSupportProvided(category);
			if (m_SupportFulfillment.Contains(category))
			{
				value = Math.Clamp(m_SupportFulfillment.Get(category) - value, 0, int.MAX);
			}
			m_SupportFulfillment.Set(category, value);
		}
	}
	
	protected void AddSupportRequirementFromSourcePart(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		//skipping utility part requirement propagation
		if (rebPart.IsUtilityPart())
			return;
		
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		int value;
		foreach (int category : tmp)
		{
			value = rebPart.GetSupportRequirement(category);
			if (m_SupportRequirement.Contains(category))
			{
				value = Math.Clamp(m_SupportRequirement.Get(category) + value, 0, int.MAX);
			}
			m_SupportRequirement.Set(category, value);
		}
	}
	
	protected void RemoveSupportRequirementFromSourcePart(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(part_name);
		//skipping utility part requirement propagation
		if (rebPart.IsUtilityPart())
			return;
		
		set<int> tmp = rebPart.GetConfiguredSupportCategories();
		int value;
		foreach (int category : tmp)
		{
			value = rebPart.GetSupportRequirement(category);
			if (m_SupportRequirement.Contains(category))
			{
				value = Math.Clamp(m_SupportRequirement.Get(category) - value, 0, int.MAX);
			}
			m_SupportRequirement.Set(category, value);
		}
	}
	
	override bool HasDependentPart(string part_name)
	{
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart;
		foreach (ConstructionPart part : m_BuiltConstructionPartArray)
		{
			if (Class.CastTo(rebPart, part) && !rebPart.IsUtilityPart())
			{
				if (rebPart.GetRequiredParts().Find(part_name) != -1)
					return true;
				
				TConstructionPartVariantArray tmpArr = rebPart.GetRequiredPartsVariants();
				if (tmpArr)
				{
					foreach (array<string> variantGroup : tmpArr)
					{
						foreach (string partName : variantGroup)
						{
							if (partName == part_name) //part_name needed
								return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		
		return false;
	}
	
	override protected array<string> GetValidDepenentPartsArray(string part_name, array<string> recurs = null)
	{
		string name = "";
		array<string> dependentParts = new array<string>();
		
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart;
		foreach (ConstructionPart part : m_BuiltConstructionPartArray)
		{
			if (Class.CastTo(rebPart, part))
			{
				name = rebPart.GetPartName();
				array<string> reqPartsArray = rebPart.GetRequiredParts();
				if (reqPartsArray && reqPartsArray.Find(part_name) > -1)
				{
					if (!recurs || (recurs.Find(name) == -1))
					dependentParts.Insert(name);
				}
				
				TConstructionPartVariantArray tmpArr = rebPart.GetRequiredPartsVariants();
				if (tmpArr)
				{
					foreach (array<string> variantGroup : tmpArr)
					{
						foreach (string partName : variantGroup)
						{
							if (partName == part_name) //part_name needed
								dependentParts.Insert(name);
						}
					}
				}
				
				if (!PartHasAnySupportFulfilled(name) && dependentParts.Find(name) == -1)
				{
					dependentParts.Insert(name);
				}
			}
		}
		
		return dependentParts;
	}
	
	//============================================
	//UI-related getters
	//============================================
	//! client-side distance checks (valid memory point and configuration required)
	override bool CanDisplayAttachmentCategoryConstruction(string categoryName)
	{
		if (!super.CanDisplayAttachmentCategoryConstruction(categoryName))
			return false;
		
		array<ConstructionPartTypeData> GUIRequiredParts = m_TypeLevelHolder.GetGuiRequiredPartTypesMap().Get(categoryName);
		if (GUIRequiredParts.Count() > 0)
		{
			foreach (ConstructionPartTypeData partTypeData : GUIRequiredParts)
			{
				if (!GetConstructionPart(partTypeData.GetPartName()).IsBuilt())
					return false;
			}
		}
		
		//legacy dependency check, just in case
		ConstructionPartRebuild rebPart = GetRebuildingPart(categoryName);
		if (rebPart)
		{
			if (!rebPart.IsBuilt() || !HasRequiredPart(rebPart.GetPartName()))
				return false;
		}
		
		return true;
	}
}

class RecipeCacheData
{
	int m_Mask;
	int m_BitCount;
	
	void RecipeCacheData(int mask)
	{
		SetMask(mask);
	}
	
	int GetMask()
	{
		return m_Mask;
	}
	
	int GetBitCount()
	{
		return m_BitCount;
	}
	
	void SetMask(int mask)
	{
		m_Mask = mask;
		m_BitCount = Math.GetNumberOfSetBits(mask);
	}
	
}

class CacheObject
{
	ref map<int, ref RecipeCacheData> m_Recipes;
	ref array<int> m_RecipeIDs;
	//RecipeCacheData data;
	void CacheObject()
	{
		m_Recipes = new map<int, ref RecipeCacheData>;
		m_RecipeIDs = new array<int>;
	}

	bool AddRecipe(int recipe_id, int mask)
	{
		RecipeCacheData data = m_Recipes.Get(recipe_id);
		if(data)
		{
			UpdateMask(recipe_id, mask);
		}
		else
		{
			m_Recipes.Insert(recipe_id, new RecipeCacheData(mask));
			m_RecipeIDs.Insert(recipe_id);

		}
		return true;
	}


	void UpdateMask(int recipe_id, int mask)
	{
		RecipeCacheData data = m_Recipes.Get(recipe_id);
		data.SetMask(data.GetMask() | mask);
		
	}

	
	int GetNumberOfRecipes()
	{
		return m_Recipes.Count();
	}
	
	array<int> GetRecipes()
	{
		return m_RecipeIDs;
	}
	
	bool IsContainRecipe(int recipe_id)
	{
		return m_Recipes.Contains(recipe_id);
	}
	
	int GetMaskByRecipeID(int recipe_id)
	{
		RecipeCacheData cache_data = m_Recipes.Get(recipe_id);
		if(cache_data)
			return cache_data.GetMask();
		return 0;
	}
	
	int GetBitCountByRecipeID(int recipe_id)
	{
		RecipeCacheData cache_data = m_Recipes.Get(recipe_id);
		if(cache_data)
			return cache_data.GetBitCount();
		return 0;
	}
	
	void DebugPrint()
	{
		for(int i = 0; i < m_Recipes.Count();i++)
		{
			Print("recipeID:"+m_Recipes.GetKey(i).ToString());
			Print("mask:"+m_Recipes.GetElement(i).m_Mask.ToString());
			Print("m_BitCount:"+m_Recipes.GetElement(i).m_BitCount.ToString());
			
		}
	}
}

		return false;
	}
	
	bool CheckIngredientMatch(ItemBase item1, ItemBase item2)
	{
		if (item1 == NULL || item2 == NULL) return false;
		
		m_Items[0] = item1;
		m_Items[1] = item2;
		
		bool found = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)//all ingredients
		{
			found = false;
			array<string> tempArray = m_Ingredients[i];
			for (int x = 0; x < tempArray.Count(); x++)//particular ingredient array
			{
				for (int z = 0; z < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; z++)
				{
					if (m_Items[z] != NULL)
					{
						ItemBase item = m_Items[z];
						if (tempArray.Get(x) == item.GetType() || g_Game.IsKindOf(item.GetType(),tempArray.Get(x)))
						{
							found = true;//we found a match
							//m_IngredientsSorted.Insert(item);
							m_IngredientsSorted[i] = item;
							m_Items[z] = NULL;
						}
					}
					if (found) break;//we found a match, no need to check the remaining ingredients
				}
				if (found) break;//we found a match, no need to check this m_Ingredient array
			}
			if (!found) return false;// no match within an m_Ingredient array, no reason to continue the search, recipe is invalid
		}
		
		if (found)
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	void InsertIngredient(int index, string ingredient, DayZPlayerConstants uid = BASE_CRAFT_ANIMATION_ID, bool showItem = false)
	{
		InsertIngredientEx(index, ingredient, "", uid, showItem);
	}
	
	void InsertIngredientEx(int index, string ingredient, string soundCategory, DayZPlayerConstants uid = BASE_CRAFT_ANIMATION_ID, bool showItem = false)
	{
		array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[index];
		ptr.Insert(ingredient);
		m_SoundCategories[index].Insert(soundCategory);

		if(uid != BASE_CRAFT_ANIMATION_ID)
		{
			RecipeAnimationInfo rai = new RecipeAnimationInfo(ingredient, uid, showItem);
			int animationIndex;
			for(animationIndex = 0; animationIndex < m_AnimationInfos.Count(); animationIndex++)
			{
				if(g_Game.IsKindOf(ingredient, m_AnimationInfos[animationIndex].m_IngredientName))
					break;
			}
			m_AnimationInfos.InsertAt(rai, animationIndex);
		}
	}
	
	void RemoveIngredient(int index, string ingredient)
	{
		array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[index];
		for (int i = 0; i < ptr.Count(); i++)
		{
			if (ptr[i] == ingredient)
			{
				ptr.Remove(i);
				m_SoundCategories[index].Remove(i);
				return;
			}
		}
	}

	//spawns results in the world
	void SpawnItems(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player, array<ItemBase> spawned_objects)
	{
		spawned_objects.Clear();//just to make sure
		EntityAI object = NULL;
		
		for (int i = 0; i < m_NumberOfResults; i++)
		{
			string item_to_spawn = m_ItemsToCreate[i];
			
			if (m_ResultInheritsColor[i] != -1)
			{
				ItemBase item = ingredients[m_ResultInheritsColor[i]];
				string color = item.ConfigGetString("color");
				string new_class_name = m_ItemsToCreate[i] + color;
				item_to_spawn = new_class_name;
			}
			
			if (m_ResultToInventory[i] == -1) 
			{
				Debug.Log("  = "+m_ResultToInventory[i].ToString(),"recipes");
				/*
				InventoryLocation inv_loc = new InventoryLocation;
				if (player.GetInventory().FindFirstFreeLocationForNewEntity(item_to_spawn, FindInventoryLocationType.ANY, inv_loc))
				{
					object = SpawnItemOnLocation(item_to_spawn, inv_loc, false);
				}
				*/
				object = player.GetInventory().CreateInInventory(item_to_spawn);
			}
			else if (m_ResultToInventory[i] >= 0)
			{
				/*
				object = player.SpawnEntityOnGroundOnCursorDir(item_to_spawn, 0.5);

				ItemBase item_swap_with = ingredients[m_ResultToInventory[i]];
				player.SwapEntities(true, item_swap_with, EntityAI.Cast(object));
				*/
			}
			
			//spawning in inventory failed, spawning on the ground instead.....
			if (!object)
			{
				object = player.SpawnEntityOnGroundRaycastDispersed(item_to_spawn,m_ResultSpawnDistance[i]);
				
				if (!object)
					Error("failed to spawn entity "+item_to_spawn+" , make sure the classname exists and item can be spawned");
			}
			spawned_objects.Insert(ItemBase.Cast(object));
			object = null;
		}
	}

	//applies final modifications to results
	void ApplyModificationsResults(ItemBase sorted[], array<ItemBase> results, ItemBase result, PlayerBase player)
	{
		float all_ingredients_health = 0;//this is used later in results
		float all_ingredients_health01 = 0;//combined damage % of ingredients
		int value_delta;
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			ItemBase ingrd = ItemBase.Cast(sorted[i]);
			all_ingredients_health += ingrd.GetHealth("", "");//accumulate health of all ingredients, used in results
			all_ingredients_health01 += ingrd.GetHealth01("", "");
		}
		//------------------- results ----------------------
		for (i = 0; i < m_NumberOfResults; i++)
		{
			ItemBase res = results.Get(i);
			if (!res)
			{
				continue;
			}
			
			if (res.IsItemBase())
			{
				value_delta = m_ResultSetQuantity[i];

				ItemBase resIb = ItemBase.Cast(res);
				
				if (!resIb.IsMagazine())//is not a magazine
				{
					if (m_ResultSetFullQuantity[i] == 1)//<------m_ResultSetFullQuantity
					{
						resIb.SetQuantityMax();
					}
					else if (value_delta != -1)//<------m_ResultSetQuantity
					{
						resIb.SetQuantity(value_delta);
					}
				}
				else//is magazine
				{
					Magazine mgzn = Magazine.Cast(resIb);
					if (m_ResultSetFullQuantity[i] == 1)//<------m_ResultSetFullQuantity
					{
						mgzn.ServerSetAmmoMax();
					}
					else if (value_delta != -1)//<------m_ResultSetQuantity
					{
						mgzn.ServerSetAmmoCount(value_delta);
					}
				}
			}
			if (m_ResultSetHealth[i] != -1)//<------m_ResultSetHealth
			{
				value_delta = m_ResultSetHealth[i];
				res.SetHealth("","",value_delta);
			}
			if (m_ResultInheritsHealth[i] != -1)//<------m_ResultInheritsHealth
			{
				if (m_ResultInheritsHealth[i] >= 0)
				{
					int ing_number = m_ResultInheritsHealth[i];
					ItemBase ing = sorted[ing_number];
					
					if (ing)
					{
						float ing_health01 = ing.GetHealth01("","");
						res.SetHealth("", "", ing_health01 * res.GetMaxHealth("",""));
						Debug.Log("Inheriting health from ingredient:"+m_ResultInheritsHealth[i].ToString(),"recipes");
					}
				}
				else if (m_ResultInheritsHealth[i] == -2)
				{
					float average_health01 = all_ingredients_health01 / MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS;
					res.SetHealth("", "", average_health01 * res.GetMaxHealth("",""));
				}
			}

			if (m_ResultReplacesIngredient[i] != -1)//<------ResultReplacesIngredient
			{
				if (m_ResultReplacesIngredient[i] > -1)
				{
					int ing_num = m_ResultReplacesIngredient[i];
					ItemBase ingr = sorted[ing_num];
					
					if (ingr)
					{
						MiscGameplayFunctions.TransferItemProperties(ingr, res, true, true, false, false);
						MiscGameplayFunctions.TransferInventory(ingr, res, player);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	
	void DeleleIngredientsPass()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < m_IngredientsToBeDeleted.Count(); i++)
		{
			ItemBase ingredient = m_IngredientsToBeDeleted.Get(i);
			ingredient.Delete();
		}
		m_IngredientsToBeDeleted.Clear();
	}
	
	//applies final modifications to ingredients
	void ApplyModificationsIngredients(ItemBase sorted[], PlayerBase player)
	{
		//---------------------- ingredients ----------------------
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			ItemBase ingredient = sorted[i];
			
			if (m_IngredientDestroy[i] == 1)//<------m_IngredientDestroy
			{
				if (ingredient) m_IngredientsToBeDeleted.Insert(ingredient);
			}
			else
			{
				if (m_IngredientAddHealth[i] != 0)//<------m_IngredientAddHealth
				{
					float health_delta = m_IngredientAddHealth[i];
					ingredient.AddHealth("","",health_delta);
				}
				else if (m_IngredientSetHealth[i] != -1)//<------m_IngredientSetHealth
				{
					float new_health = m_IngredientSetHealth[i];
					ingredient.SetHealth("","",new_health);
				}
				if (m_IngredientAddQuantity[i] != 0)//<------m_IngredientAddQuantity
				{
					float quantity_delta = m_IngredientAddQuantity[i];
						
					if (!ingredient.IsMagazine())
					{
						ItemBase obj = ingredient;
						bool isDestroyed = obj.AddQuantity(quantity_delta, true);
						if (isDestroyed) 
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Magazine mag = Magazine.Cast(ingredient);
						int newQuantity = mag.GetAmmoCount() + quantity_delta;
						if (newQuantity <= 0)
						{
							if (mag) m_IngredientsToBeDeleted.Insert(mag);
							continue;
						}
						else
						{
							mag.ServerSetAmmoCount(newQuantity);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	//checks the recipe conditions
	bool CheckConditions(ItemBase sorted[])
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			ItemBase ingredient = sorted[i];
			if (!ingredient.IsMagazine())
			{
				if (ingredient.GetQuantityMax() !=0 && m_MinQuantityIngredient[i] >= 0 && ingredient.GetQuantity() < m_MinQuantityIngredient[i])
				{
					//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MinQuantityIngredient","recipes");
					return false;
				}
				if (m_MaxQuantityIngredient[i] >= 0 && ingredient.GetQuantity() > m_MaxQuantityIngredient[i])
				{
					//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MaxQuantityIngredient","recipes");
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Magazine mag1 = Magazine.Cast(ingredient);
				if (m_MinQuantityIngredient[i] >= 0 && mag1.GetAmmoCount() < m_MinQuantityIngredient[i])
				{
					//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MinQuantityIngredient[0]","recipes");
					return false;
				}
				if (m_MaxQuantityIngredient[i] >= 0 && mag1.GetAmmoCount() > m_MaxQuantityIngredient[i])
				{
					//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MaxQuantityIngredient[0]","recipes");
					return false;
				}
			}
			int dmg3 = ingredient.GetHealthLevel();
			if (m_MinDamageIngredient[i] >= 0 && ingredient.GetHealthLevel() < m_MinDamageIngredient[i])
			{
				int dmg = ingredient.GetHealthLevel();
				//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MinDamageIngredient[0]","recipes");
				return false;
			}
			if (m_MaxDamageIngredient[i] >= 0 && ingredient.GetHealthLevel() > m_MaxDamageIngredient[i])
			{
				int dmg2 = ingredient.GetHealthLevel();
				//Debug.Log("Recipe condition check failing1: m_MaxDamageIngredient[0]","recipes");
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	//checks overall validity of this recipe
	bool CheckRecipe(ItemBase item1, ItemBase item2, PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (item1 == NULL || item2 == NULL)
		{
			Error("recipe invalid, at least one of the ingredients is NULL");
			return false;
		}
		
		ItemBase item_in_hand = player.GetItemInHands();
		
		if (!IsRecipeAnywhere() && (item1 != item_in_hand && item2 != item_in_hand))
		{
			return false;
		}
		
		m_IngredientsSorted[0] = item1;
		m_IngredientsSorted[1] = item2;
	
		if (CanDo(m_IngredientsSorted, player) && CheckConditions(m_IngredientsSorted))
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
	
	void OnSelectedRecipe(ItemBase item1, ItemBase item2, PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (item1 == NULL || item2 == NULL)
		{
			Error("CheckRecipe: recipe invalid, at least one of the ingredients is NULL");
			//Debug.Log("recipe invalid, at least one of the ingredients is NULL","recipes");
			return;
		}
		OnSelected(item1,item2,player);
	}
	
	void OnSelected(ItemBase item1, ItemBase item2, PlayerBase player)
	{
		
	}

	//performs this recipe
	void PerformRecipe(ItemBase item1, ItemBase item2, PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (item1 == NULL || item2 == NULL)
		{
			Error("PerformRecipe: recipe invalid, at least one of the ingredients is NULL");
			Debug.Log("PerformRecipe: at least one of the ingredients is NULL","recipes");
		}
		
		if (CheckRecipe(item1,item2,player))
		{
			array<ItemBase> spawned_objects = new array<ItemBase>;
			SpawnItems(m_IngredientsSorted, player,spawned_objects);
			
			ApplyModificationsResults(m_IngredientsSorted, spawned_objects, NULL, player);
			ApplyModificationsIngredients(m_IngredientsSorted, player);
			
			Do(m_IngredientsSorted, player, spawned_objects, m_Specialty);
			
			DeleleIngredientsPass();
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.Log("CheckRecipe failed on server","recipes");
		}
	}

	void GetAllItems(array<string> items)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[i];
			
			for (int x = 0; x < ptr.Count(); x++)
			{
				items.Insert(ptr.Get(x));
			}
		}
	}
	
	string GetSoundCategory(int ingredientIndex, ItemBase item)
	{
		string itemType = item.GetType();
		array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[ingredientIndex];
		
		for (int x = 0; x < ptr.Count(); x++)
		{
			if (g_Game.IsKindOf(itemType, ptr.Get(x)))
			{
				return m_SoundCategories[ingredientIndex].Get(x);
			}
		}
		return "";
	}

	bool IsItemInRecipe(string item)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[i];
			
			for (int x = 0; x < ptr.Count(); x++)
			{
				if (ptr.Get(x) == item) return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
	
	//! returns a mask which marks ingredient positions for a given item in this recipe(for example mask of value 3 [....000011] means this item is both ingredient 1 and 2 in this recipe[from right to left])
	int GetIngredientMaskForItem(string item)
	{
		int mask = 0;
		
		for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUMBER_OF_INGREDIENTS; i++)
		{
			array<string> ptr = m_Ingredients[i];
			
			for (int x = 0; x < ptr.Count(); x++)
			{
				if (ptr.Get(x) == item)
				{
					mask = ((int)Math.Pow(2, i)) | mask;
				}
			}
		}
		return mask;
	}

	{
		return BASE_CRAFT_ANIMATION_ID;

	RecipeAnimationInfo GetRecipeAnimationInfo(PlayerBase player, ItemBase mainItem, ItemBase target)
	{
		RecipeAnimationInfo recipeAnimationInfo;
		
		int found = false;
		
		for(int i = 0; i < m_AnimationInfos.Count();i++)
		{
			recipeAnimationInfo = m_AnimationInfos[i];
			if(g_Game.IsKindOf(mainItem.GetType(), recipeAnimationInfo.m_IngredientName))
			{
				found = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		if(!found)
		{
			recipeAnimationInfo = new RecipeAnimationInfo("ItemBase", BASE_CRAFT_ANIMATION_ID, false);
		}

		return recipeAnimationInfo;
	}
}

class AttachHolster extends RecipeBase
{	
	override void Init()
	{
		m_Name = "#STR_AttachHolster0";
		m_IsInstaRecipe = false;//should this recipe be performed instantly without animation
		m_AnimationLength = 0.5;//animation length in relative time units
		m_Specialty = 0.02;// value > 0 for roughness, value < 0 for precision
		
		
		//conditions
		m_MinDamageIngredient[0] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxDamageIngredient[0] = 3;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinQuantityIngredient[0] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxQuantityIngredient[0] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinDamageIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxDamageIngredient[1] = 3;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinQuantityIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxQuantityIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//INGREDIENTS
		//ingredient 1
		InsertIngredient(0,"PlateCarrierBlank");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[0] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[0] = true;//true = destroy, false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		
		//ingredient 2
		InsertIngredient(1,"CarrierHolsterSolo");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[1] = true;// false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[1] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//result1
		AddResult("PlateCarrierHolster");//add results here

		m_ResultSetFullQuantity[0] = false;//true = set full quantity, false = do nothing
		m_ResultSetQuantity[0] = -1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultSetHealth[0] = -1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultInheritsHealth[0] = 0;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result will inherit health from ingredient number (value);(value) == -2 means this result will inherit health from all ingredients averaged(result_health = combined_health_of_ingredients / number_of_ingredients)
		m_ResultInheritsColor[0] = -1;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result classname will be a composite of the name provided in AddResult method and config value "color" of ingredient (value)
		m_ResultToInventory[0] = -2;//(value) == -2 spawn result on the ground;(value) == -1 place anywhere in the players inventory, (value) >= 0 means switch position with ingredient number(value)
		m_ResultUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this result
		m_ResultReplacesIngredient[0] = -1;// value == -1 means do nothing; a value >= 0 means this result will transfer item propertiesvariables, attachments etc.. from an ingredient value
	}

	override bool CanDo(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player)//final check for recipe's validity
	{
		ItemBase ingredient1 = ingredients[0];
		ItemBase ingredient2 = ingredients[1];
		
		if( ingredient1.IsEmpty() && ingredient2.IsEmpty() )
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
};

		m_MaxDamageIngredient[0] = 3;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinQuantityIngredient[0] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxQuantityIngredient[0] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinDamageIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxDamageIngredient[1] = 3;//-1 = disable check
		
		m_MinQuantityIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		m_MaxQuantityIngredient[1] = -1;//-1 = disable check
		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//INGREDIENTS
		//ingredient 1
		InsertIngredient(0,"Rag");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[0] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[0] = false;//true = destroy, false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		
		//ingredient 2
		InsertIngredient(1,"Pot");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"CanisterGasoline");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"Canteen");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"WaterBottle");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"FilteringBottle");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"GlassBottle");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"WaterPouch_ColorBase");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"Barrel_ColorBase");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"AyranBottle");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way		
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[1] = false;// false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[1] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
	}

	override bool CanDo(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player)//final check for recipe's validity
	{
		ItemBase rags;
		Class.CastTo(rags, ingredients[0]);
		ItemBase container;
		Class.CastTo(container, ingredients[1]);
		
		if ((container.GetLiquidType() & LIQUID_WATER) && container.GetQuantity() > 0 && !container.GetIsFrozen() && rags.GetHealthLevel() > 1)
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	override void Do(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player,array<ItemBase> results, float specialty_weight)//gets called upon recipe's completion
	{
		ItemBase rags = ingredients[0];
		ItemBase container = ingredients[1];
		
		float 	rags_health 	= rags.GetHealth("","");
		int 	rags_quantity 	= rags.GetQuantity();
		
		float 	rags_combined_damage = (100 - rags_health) * rags_quantity;
		
		int 	liquid_quantity = container.GetQuantity();
		int 	liquid_required = rags_combined_damage * 2;
		
		float 	used_ratio = 0;
		float	heal = 0;
		
		if( liquid_quantity > liquid_required )
		{
			container.AddQuantity(-liquid_required);
			heal = 	rags_combined_damage / rags_quantity;
		}
		else
		{
			container.SetQuantity(0);
			used_ratio = liquid_quantity / liquid_required;
			heal = 	(rags_combined_damage / rags_quantity) * used_ratio;
			
		}
		heal = Math.Clamp(heal, 0, (70 - rags_health));
		rags.AddHealth("", "",heal);
	}
};

class CloseGunCase extends RecipeBase
{	
	
	protected ref map<string, string> m_AllowedCombines;
	
	void CloseGunCase()
	{
		m_AllowedCombines = new map<string, string>();
		m_AllowedCombines.Insert("GunCase_Black", "GunCaseKeys_Blue");
		m_AllowedCombines.Insert("GunCase_Orange", "GunCaseKeys_Orange");
		m_AllowedCombines.Insert("GunCase_White", "GunCaseKeys_Red");
	}
	
	override void Init()
	{
		m_Name = "#lock";
		m_IsInstaRecipe = false;//should this recipe be performed instantly without animation
		m_AnimationLength = 1;//animation length in relative time units
		m_Specialty = 0.03;// value > 0 for roughness, value < 0 for precision
		
		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//INGREDIENTS
		//ingredient 1
		InsertIngredient(0,"GunCase_ColorBase");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[0] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[0] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[0] = false;//true = destroy, false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		m_MaxDamageIngredient[0] = 3;
		
		//ingredient 2
		InsertIngredient(1,"GunCaseKeys_Colorbase");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[1] = -0.5;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[1] = false;// false = do nothing
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[1] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		m_MaxDamageIngredient[1] = 3;
		
		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	}
	
	override bool CanDo(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player)
	{
		GunCase_ColorBase gncs = GunCase_ColorBase.Cast(ingredients[0]);
		GunCaseKeys_Colorbase key = GunCaseKeys_Colorbase.Cast(ingredients[1]);
		foreach (string caseName, string keyName: m_AllowedCombines)
		{
			if (caseName == gncs.GetType() && keyName == key.GetType())
				return gncs.IsOpen();
		}
		
		return false;
	}
	
	override void Do(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player,array<ItemBase> results, float specialty_weight)
	{
		GunCase_ColorBase gncs = GunCase_ColorBase.Cast(ingredients[0]);
		gncs.Close();
	}
};

		//ingredient 2

		m_IngredientAddHealth[1] = 0;
		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[1] = 0;
		m_IngredientDestroy[1] = true;
		m_IngredientUseSoftSkills[1] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this ingredient
		
		// crafting multiple results
		//AddResult("CombatKnife");//additional results, must be processed individually in Do method (as "results" parameter)
		
		
		AddResult("BarbedBaseballBat");//single result
		m_ResultSetFullQuantity[0] = 0;
		m_ResultSetQuantity[0] = -1;
		m_ResultSetHealth[0] = -1;
		m_ResultInheritsHealth[0] = 1;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result will inherit health from ingredient number (value);(value) == -2 means this result will inherit health from all ingredients averaged(result_health = combined_health_of_ingredients / number_of_ingredients)
		m_ResultInheritsColor[0] = -1;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result classname will be a composite of the name provided in AddResult method and config value "color" of ingredient (value)
		m_ResultToInventory[0] = 1; //(value) == -2 spawn result on the ground;(value) == -1 place anywhere in the players inventory, (value) >= 0 means switch position with ingredient number(value)
		m_ResultUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this result
		m_ResultReplacesIngredient[0] = -1;// value == -1 means do nothing; a value >= 0 means this result will transfer item propertiesvariables, attachments etc.. from an ingredient value
	}

	
	override void Do( ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player, array<ItemBase> results, float specialty_weight )//gets called upon recipe's completion
	{
		ItemBase gloves = ItemBase.Cast(player.FindAttachmentBySlotName("Gloves"));
		if ( gloves && !gloves.IsDamageDestroyed() )
			return;

		int rand = Math.RandomIntInclusive(0,9);
		if ( rand == 0 )
		{
			rand = Math.RandomIntInclusive(0,1);
			if ( rand == 0 && !player.GetBleedingManagerServer().AttemptAddBleedingSourceBySelection("LeftForeArmRoll") )
			{
				player.GetBleedingManagerServer().AttemptAddBleedingSourceBySelection("RightForeArmRoll");
			}
			else if ( rand == 1 && !player.GetBleedingManagerServer().AttemptAddBleedingSourceBySelection("RightForeArmRoll") )
			{
				player.GetBleedingManagerServer().AttemptAddBleedingSourceBySelection("LeftForeArmRoll");
			}
		}
	}
};

		InsertIngredientEx(1,"EyeMask_ColorBase",	"FireplaceDeploy");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredientEx(1,"MorsecodeLeaflet_blood",	"FireplaceDeploy");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredientEx(1,"MorsecodeLeaflet_fire",	"FireplaceDeploy");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredientEx(1,"MorsecodeLeaflet_coffee",	"FireplaceDeploy");//you can insert multiple ingredients this way

		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing

		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//result1
		AddResult("Fireplace");//add results here

		m_ResultSetFullQuantity[0] = false;//true = set full quantity, false = do nothing
		m_ResultSetQuantity[0] = -1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultSetHealth[0] = -1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultInheritsHealth[0] = -2;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result will inherit health from ingredient number (value);(value) == -2 means this result will inherit health from all ingredients averaged(result_health = combined_health_of_ingredients / number_of_ingredients)
		m_ResultInheritsColor[0] = -1;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result classname will be a composite of the name provided in AddResult method and config value "color" of ingredient (value)
		m_ResultToInventory[0] = -2;//(value) == -2 spawn result on the ground;(value) == -1 place anywhere in the players inventory, (value) >= 0 means switch position with ingredient number(value)
		m_ResultUseSoftSkills[0] = false;// set 'true' to allow modification of the values by softskills on this result
		m_ResultReplacesIngredient[0] = -1;// value == -1 means do nothing; a value >= 0 means this result will transfer item propertiesvariables, attachments etc.. from an ingredient value
	}

	override bool CanDo(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player)//final check for recipe's validity
	{
		ItemBase ingredient1 = ingredients[0];
		ItemBase ingredient2 = ingredients[1];
		
		if ( ingredient1.Type() == ingredient2.Type() || ingredient1.GetInventory().GetSlotId(0) == ingredient2.GetInventory().GetSlotId(0) )
		{
			return false;
		}
		
		return true;
	}

	override void Do( ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player, array<ItemBase> results, float specialty_weight )//gets called upon recipe's completion
	{
		ItemBase result = ItemBase.Cast( results.Get( 0 ) );
		ItemBase ingredient1 = ingredients[0];
		ItemBase ingredient2 = ingredients[1];
		
		//clear inventory reservation
		if ( !g_Game.IsMultiplayer() )
		{
			InventoryLocation loc = new InventoryLocation;
			ingredient1.GetInventory().GetCurrentInventoryLocation( loc );
			player.GetInventory().ClearInventoryReservationEx( ingredient1, loc );
			ingredient2.GetInventory().GetCurrentInventoryLocation( loc );
			player.GetInventory().ClearInventoryReservationEx( ingredient2, loc );			
		}
		
		//Ingredient 1
		if ( ingredient1.GetQuantity() <= 0 )
		{
			if ( g_Game.IsServer() && g_Game.IsMultiplayer() )
			{
				player.ServerTakeEntityToTargetAttachment( result, ingredient1 ); // multiplayer server side
			}
			else
			{
				player.LocalTakeEntityToTargetAttachment( result, ingredient1 ); // single player or multiplayer client side
			}
		}
		else
		{
			string ingredient1_classname = ingredient1.GetType();
			ItemBase attachment1 = ItemBase.Cast( result.GetInventory().CreateAttachment( ingredient1_classname ) );
			MiscGameplayFunctions.TransferItemProperties( ingredient1, attachment1 );
			attachment1.SetQuantity( 1 );
			attachment1.SetCleanness(0);
			
			//set quantity to ingredient
			ingredient1.AddQuantity( -1 );
		}
		
		//Ingredient 2
		if ( ingredient2.GetQuantity() <= 0 )
		{
			if ( g_Game.IsServer() && g_Game.IsMultiplayer() )
			{
				player.ServerTakeEntityToTargetAttachment( result, ingredient2 ); // multiplayer server side
			}
			else
			{
				player.LocalTakeEntityToTargetAttachment( result, ingredient2 ); // single player or multiplayer client side
			}
		}
		else
		{
			string ingredient2_classname = ingredient2.GetType();
			ItemBase attachment2 = ItemBase.Cast( result.GetInventory().CreateAttachment( ingredient2_classname ) );
			MiscGameplayFunctions.TransferItemProperties( ingredient2, attachment2 );
			attachment2.SetQuantity( 1 );
			attachment2.SetCleanness(0);
			//set quantity to ingredient
			ingredient2.AddQuantity( -1 );
		}
	}
}

	{
		ItemBase rag = ingredients[0];
		rag.SetCleanness(0);
		Torch torch = Torch.Cast(results[0]);
		torch.SetTorchDecraftResult(ingredients[1].GetType());
		
		if ( g_Game.IsMultiplayer() && g_Game.IsServer() )
		{
			player.ServerTakeEntityToTargetAttachment(torch, rag);
			
		}
		else if ( !g_Game.IsMultiplayer() )
		{
			player.LocalTakeEntityToTargetAttachment(torch, rag);
		}
		
		torch.StandUp();
		torch.CraftingInit(rag.GetQuantity());
	}
};

		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
		m_IngredientAddQuantity[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientDestroy[1] = false;// false = do nothing

		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		//result1

		m_ResultSetFullQuantity[0] = false;//true = set full quantity, false = do nothing
		m_ResultSetQuantity[0] = 1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultSetHealth[0] = -1;//-1 = do nothing
		m_ResultInheritsHealth[0] = 0;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result will inherit health from ingredient number (value);(value) == -2 means this result will inherit health from all ingredients averaged(result_health = combined_health_of_ingredients / number_of_ingredients)
		m_ResultInheritsColor[0] = 0;// (value) == -1 means do nothing; a (value) >= 0 means this result classname will be a composite of the name provided in AddResult method and config value "color" of ingredient (value)
		m_ResultToInventory[0] = -2;//(value) == -2 spawn result on the ground;(value) == -1 place anywhere in the players inventory, (value) >= 0 means switch position with ingredient number(value)

		//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	}
	
	override void Do(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player,array<ItemBase> results, float specialty_weight)//gets called upon recipe's completion
	{
		MetalWire wire = MetalWire.Cast( results[0] );
		if ( wire )
		{
			float health = ingredients[0].GetHealth("",""); //we want the result health is based on the real health of barbed wire, not the level of it.
			health = health * 0.85; //decreasing the health a bit, simulating damaging with pliers.
			wire.SetHealth("","", health);
		}
	}
	
	override bool CanDo(ItemBase ingredients[], PlayerBase player)
	{
		if (ingredients[0] && ingredients[0].GetInventory().IsAttachment())
			return false;
		
		return true;
	}
};

		InsertIngredient(1,"CanisterGasoline", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"Canteen", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"WaterBottle", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"FilteringBottle", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"GlassBottle", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"WineBottle", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"WaterPouch_ColorBase", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"Barrel_ColorBase", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way
		InsertIngredient(1,"AyranBottle", DayZPlayerConstants.CMD_ACTIONFB_MIX_MORTAR);//you can insert multiple ingredients this way

		
		m_IngredientAddHealth[1] = 0;// 0 = do nothing
		m_IngredientSetHealth[1] = -1; // -1 = do nothing
